query: I have an 84-year-old female to evaluate. Among female Medicare patients age 79–89 admitted from the emergency department with a principal diagnosis of pneumonia, how many admissions overall were included in that cohort in the dataset during the study period?
final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS total_admissions FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age = 84 AND p.insurance = 'Medicare' AND p.anchor_year_group = '79-89' AND d.icd_code = '440.0' AND a.admission_type = 'ED';
